items.title: The stack of etale sheaves on schemes over a base for the h-topology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a scheme S the category fibred in groupoids over the h-site whose fibre over U is the category of sheaves on the small etale site of U is a stack in groupoids (statement lines 23256-23264). The proof (proof lines 23266-23285) checks the three conditions of the criterion for h-stacks: Zariski glueing, descent along a surjective flat proper finitely presented cover, and the modification condition. H2: three verifications, each written out with its input.
